member.name: T:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AdminController
member.summary: Administration controller for system-wide user and organiser management. Provides endpoints for viewing all users, creating organisers, and managing permissions.

member.name: M:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AdminController.GetAllUsers
member.summary: Retrieves a list of all users in the system with their roles.
member.remarks: Returns all registered users along with their roles (organiser/participant status). Requires authentication.
member.returns: List of all users with UserID, Email, FullName, Phone, IsOrganiser, IsParticipant, and CreatedAt

member.name: M:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AdminController.GetUserById(System.Int32)
member.summary: Retrieves a specific user by ID with detailed information and roles.
member.remarks: Returns comprehensive user information including organiser/participant status. Requires authentication.
member.param: The unique identifier of the user
member.returns: User details including UserID, Email, FullName, Phone, IsOrganiser, IsParticipant, timestamps
member.response: User with specified ID not found

member.name: M:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AdminController.CreateOrganiser(RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.CreateOrganiserRequest)
member.summary: Creates a new organiser account with associated user record.
member.remarks: Registers a new event organiser in the system. This endpoint creates both a User and Organiser record. Note: This endpoint allows anonymous access for initial system setup; restrict in production.
member.param: Organiser creation request with email, password, company name, and contact details
member.returns: Returns 201 Created with the new organiser details if successful
member.response: Email and password are required; missing required fields

member.name: T:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AuthController
member.summary: Authentication controller for user registration and login. Handles JWT token generation for authorized API access.

member.name: M:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDayManagementAPI.Models.RegisterRequest)
member.summary: Registers a new participant account.
member.remarks: Creates a new user and automatically registers them as a participant. Organisers are pre-seeded in the system and can only be created by administrators.
member.param: Registration request containing email, password, and participant details
member.returns: Returns 201 Created with the new user details if registration is successful. Returns 400 Bad Request if required fields are missing. Returns 409 Conflict if email is already registered.
member.response: Email and password are required; missing required fields

member.name: M:RaceDayManagementAPI.Controllers.AuthController.Login(RaceDayManagementAPI.Models.LoginRequest)
member.summary: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token for API access.
member.remarks: Verifies the provided email and password, then generates a JWT token valid for subsequent API calls. The token includes claims for user roles (organiser/participant).
member.returns: Returns 200 OK with JWT token and user details if authentication is successful. Returns 401 Unauthorized if email or password is invalid.
